chamber.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a quiet panoramic website backdrop for Hyper Chamber, a fighting-game practice reference application. Create a sophisticated 2D painted architectural scene, very wide 3:1 landscape, luminous ivory stone martial arts training chamber inspired by the idea of limitless time and disciplined practice. Cropped tall arches and weathered pale stone pillars at far left and far right edges, fine muted brass architectural inlay, soft long afternoon shadows. The central 65% is open, almost flat warm ivory negative space, suitable underneath a functional interface. Strong simple architectural perspective but no focal doorway in center. Desaturated warm limestone, fogged sage grey shadows, restrained aged gold. Low contrast, architectural editorial illustration, calm rather than fantasy splash art. No people, no recognizable franchise objects, no text, no logos, no clocks with digits, no hourglass ornament, no grids, no UI, no watermark. Edges fade softly into ivory so it tiles vertically by calm continuation without sharp bottom edges.
